policy.stacking: Campaign offers replace — never add to — the standing 15% newcomer/lapsed perk unless the offer says 'standard 15%'. Non-price perks (days, freezes, guest passes, retail) may sit on top of a discount.

journeys.Pop-ups: Barre/Pilates partner venues (Copper + Cloves, Plash Pilates). Paid trial class.

policy.perkValues: Private Mumbai ₹5,250 (Bengaluru ₹3,500 — confirm); retail perk ₹2,000 list (confirm); guest pass = single-class price.

offerBank.name: The 57-Hour Hangover Sale
offerBank.offerDetails: 1 Month Unlimited at a flat ₹15,000 in Mumbai (list ₹20,239, 26% off) or ₹10,000 at Kenkere (list ₹14,595, 31% off). Fri 1 Jan 00:00 to Sun 3 Jan 09:00 — 57 hours. Capped at 57 memberships per city, 1 per person, activate by 15 Jan.
offerBank.headline: Hungover? Same. 1 month unlimited, flat ₹15,000. 57 hours only.
offerBank.customerMessage: Hungover? Same. For the next 57 hours, 1 Month Unlimited is a flat ₹15,000 (Bengaluru: ₹10,000). Only 57 memberships per city, then it disappears faster than your NYE plans. Start any day before 15 Jan.
offerBank.commercialJob: Front-load January cash and capture the resolution spike before it cools.
offerBank.logic: January is the strongest non-April month in Mumbai (Jan-26: Kwality ₹27.4L, Bandra ₹20.0L; Kenkere ₹11.1L). A capped spot price creates urgency without training clients to wait — only 57 units per city, so the maximum discount exposure is ~₹3.0L in Mumbai and ~₹2.6L in Bengaluru.
offerBank.rules: Spot offer, so the >25% cap does not apply. Replaces (does not stack with) the 15% newcomer or lapsed perk. Active members may buy it as their next renewal only if their plan ends before 31 Jan.
offerBank.kpi: Sell-out time; share of spot buyers renewing in Feb at standard price (target 55%).

offerBank.name: Third Time's the Charm
offerBank.offerDetails: Replaces the Newcomers 2-for-1 for January. Mumbai: 3 classes for ₹3,885 (price of 2 singles) — mix barre, powerCycle and Strength Lab (Lab seats at Supreme HQ; Kwality off-peak only), use within 14 days. Kenkere: 3 barre classes for ₹2,835 (counts as the once-in-a-lifetime 2-for-1; replaces the 50% intro in January). Then the standard 15% on a first membership: 1 Month ₹17,203 / ₹12,406.
offerBank.headline: First class: awkward. Second: better. Third: hooked. 3 classes for the price of 2.
offerBank.customerMessage: First class: awkward. Second class: better. Third class: you're hooked. Try barre, powerCycle and Strength Lab — 3 classes for the price of 2 (₹3,885). Bengaluru: 3 barre classes for ₹2,835. Love it? Your first membership is 15% off.
offerBank.commercialJob: Lift trial-to-member conversion by getting newcomers to the 3-visit mark.
offerBank.logic: 60.6% of first-timers never take a 2nd class. Purchase within 60 days by month-1 visits: 0 return visits 10.8%, 1 → 43.9%, 2 → 73.3%, 3–4 → 88.6%. The 2-for-1 route converts 20.8% (Bandra 17%). A third class moves people into the 73–89% band.
offerBank.rules: One per person (phone verified). Intro products sit outside the 25% cap as acquisition cost. Class 2 booked at the desk before leaving class 1.
offerBank.kpi: Packs with all 3 classes used in 14 days (target 60%); pack → membership (target 35% vs 20.8% on 2-for-1).

offerBank.name: The Baker's Dozen
offerBank.offerDetails: Annual Unlimited at 15% off — Mumbai ₹1,86,533 (list ₹2,19,450), Kenkere ₹1,32,804 (list ₹1,56,240) — for 13 months instead of 12, plus the standard annual perks (2 privates, 4 guest passes, 1 hosted class, monthly trainer check-ins).
offerBank.headline: 12 months is so 2026. Renew your annual and get 13.
offerBank.customerMessage: 12 months is so 2026. Renew your annual this January and we'll bake in a 13th month — plus your 2 privates, 4 guest passes, a hosted class and monthly trainer check-ins. A baker's dozen hits different.
offerBank.commercialJob: Re-up the annuals that fall due in Dec–Feb and upgrade 3M/6M members to annual.
offerBank.logic: Annual is Kwality's #1 product (32 units, ₹51.6L in the last 12 months) and Bandra's #3 (15 units, ₹23.8L). The ANN-2026-25%-KH code gave away ₹9.7L at a flat 25%; this gives less cash away (≈21.5% effective) and adds time, which costs little at spare capacity.
offerBank.rules: ≈21.5% effective (annual cap 25%). Annual, 6M and 3M members expiring 1 Dec–28 Feb.
offerBank.kpi: Annual re-up rate (target 75%); 3M/6M → annual upgrades.

offerBank.name: U Up? It's 2027.
offerBank.offerDetails: Lapsed 61–365 days: the standard 15% on 1 Month (₹17,203 / ₹12,406) or a 12-class pack (₹16,735 / ₹11,156). Take 12 classes by 31 Jan and get +5 days (pack buyers: +1 class). Pop-ups: 15% on an 8- or 10-class pack (₹5,891 / ₹7,229) and +1 class for 6 classes by 31 Jan.
offerBank.headline: U up? Your mat's been asking about you.
offerBank.customerMessage: U up? Your mat's been asking about you. Come back this January: 15% off, and hit 12 classes this month for 5 bonus days. No awkward small talk, promise.
offerBank.commercialJob: Reactivate lapsed clients in the highest-intent month and get them active before Stronger in 30 (members-only).
offerBank.logic: Bandra is reactivation-led (3,209 lapsed vs 5,065 renewed membership records). Renewal climbs with usage: Bandra members using <50% of sessions renew 49–58% vs 82% at 75%+. The bonus is only paid for attendance that predicts the next renewal.
offerBank.rules: Standard lapsed 15%, bonus earned (≈20% effective if earned). No stacking with the spot sale.
offerBank.kpi: Lapsed buyers; share hitting 12 classes (target 40%); Feb renewal of Jan winbacks.

offerBank.name: Situationship → Relationship
offerBank.offerDetails: Mumbai: Newcomers 2-for-1 (₹1,943); take both classes within 10 days, buy 1 Month at the standard 15% (₹17,203) within 72 hours and join the Stronger in 30 Rookie track (16 classes) — finish it for +7 days. Kenkere: 50% intro (₹709) + class 2 free if booked at the desk, then the same. Pop-ups: paid trial (≈₹945) → 8-class pack at 15% (₹5,891) within 72 hours + Rookie track (8 classes).
offerBank.headline: Stop situationship-ing your fitness. Two dates, then make it official.
offerBank.customerMessage: Stop situationship-ing your fitness. Two dates, then make it official: 15% off your first month and a spot on the Stronger in 30 Rookie track. Finish it and we'll throw in an extra week. Commitment never looked this good.
offerBank.commercialJob: Convert Valentine's-season traffic into members who start the challenge.
offerBank.logic: Kenkere's VDAY50! code (38 uses, ₹2.6L given away at 50%) bought February volume at a huge cost. This replaces 50% with a structured path: a booked second visit lifts conversion from 10.8% to 43.9%; the challenge gives a reason to keep coming.
offerBank.rules: Standard 15% only; the +7 days are earned. Challenge is free with an active membership.
offerBank.kpi: Second-visit rate (target 55%); trial → member (target 30%); Rookie finish rate.

offerBank.name: Couples Therapy (Cheaper Than the Real Thing)
offerBank.offerDetails: An active member brings someone new (partner, bestie, mum, colleague) and both buy on the same day: the member gets 1 Month or a 12-class pack at 10% off (₹18,215 / ₹17,719; Kenkere ₹13,136 / ₹11,813), the new person gets their standard 15%, and the pair gets one shared 30-min duo private plus the Partner Barre class on Sun 14 Feb. Pop-ups: 10% / 15% on 8-class packs + a duo class.
offerBank.headline: Couples therapy, but cheaper and with better glutes.
offerBank.customerMessage: Couples therapy, but cheaper — and the only thing you'll fight about is who's holding the plank longer. Bring someone new: you get 10% off, they get 15% off, and you both get a 30-minute duo private.
offerBank.commercialJob: Turn members into recruiters; replace BOGO with genuinely new buyers.
offerBank.logic: Referrals convert 41.2% at Kwality, 22.6% at Bandra, 28.3% at Kenkere and 76.1% at pop-ups, versus 3.8–5.7% for website leads. The 2026 BOGO codes (70 uses, ₹3.1L given) went mostly to existing clients; this only pays out when a new person buys.
offerBank.rules: New person must be new to P57 (phone verified). Both must buy. ≈16% effective for the member.
offerBank.kpi: Pairs formed; new buyers from referral (target +40% vs Feb-26).

offerBank.name: Proof of Work
offerBank.offerDetails: Stronger in 30 finishers (30 classes): 3 Months at 15% (₹49,177 / ₹35,879), 6 Months at 20% (₹90,972 / ₹65,772) or Annual at 22% + 1 extra private (₹1,71,171 / ₹1,21,867). Rookie/Comeback finishers: 3 Months at 15%. Pop-up finishers: 10-class pack at 15% (₹7,229). Window 15 Feb–10 Mar.
offerBank.headline: You did 30 in 30. Your renewal price should show it.
offerBank.customerMessage: You did 30 classes in 30 days. Your renewal price should show it: 6 months at 20% off, or an annual at 22% off with an extra private. Receipts, not resolutions.
offerBank.commercialJob: Turn challenge attendance into 3–12 month commitments.
offerBank.logic: Renewers average 6.4 visits in the first half of a membership vs 2.6–3.4 for lapsers; members using 75%+ of sessions renew 82–88% across studios. The best price only goes to proven attenders.
offerBank.rules: Price unlocked by verified attendance. 6M at 20% and annual at ≈24% effective sit inside the caps.
offerBank.kpi: Finish rate; finisher renewal yield vs non-finishers; 3M+ share of renewal value (target 45%).

offerBank.name: Galentine's Gone Ghost
offerBank.offerDetails: A lapsed client comes back with a friend who's never been: the standard 15% on 1 Month or a 12-class pack for the returner; 2 free classes for the friend. If the friend buys within 7 days: matching P57 grip socks for both and +7 days for the returner (pack: +1 class). Galentine's class Sat 13 Feb.
offerBank.headline: Your bestie's been ghosting the gym too? Come back together.
offerBank.customerMessage: Your bestie's been ghosting the gym too? Come back together. You get 15% off, she gets 2 classes on us — and if she joins, you both get matching grip socks and you get 7 bonus days.
offerBank.commercialJob: Use lapsed clients as a warm lead source while reactivating them.
offerBank.logic: Lapsed clients already know the product and bring friends who convert like referrals (22–76%). Pairing two hesitant people raises the odds both show up.
offerBank.rules: Friend must be new. Bonus only when the friend buys (≈20% effective for the returner).
offerBank.kpi: Returners with a friend; friend → purchase (target 30%).

offerBank.focus: Women's Day + Main Character Month (format exploration)
offerBank.name: Monogamy Is Overrated
offerBank.offerDetails: For members who've used one format in the last 60 days. Pack members renew at list and get 2 bonus classes valid only in formats they've never tried (Mumbai: powerCycle / Strength Lab induction / Cardio Barre; Kenkere: Cardio Barre / Mat 57 / Foundations). Unlimited members renew at list and get +5 days if they take 3 different formats in their first 30 days.
offerBank.headline: Committed to one class? Cute. Members who play the field stay longer.
offerBank.customerMessage: Committed to one class? Cute. Members who play the field stay longer — so renew this month and we'll pay for your next two flings: 2 bonus classes in formats you've never tried.
offerBank.commercialJob: Lift renewal rates by widening each member's format mix.
offerBank.logic: One-format members renew 58–67% vs 85–87% for members on 4+ formats. Bonus classes cost little in off-peak slots and target the single biggest renewal predictor after attendance.
offerBank.rules: No price discount; ≈17% value on a 12-class pack, ≈16% on 1M if the bonus is earned.
offerBank.kpi: Members trying a new format (target 40% of eligible); 60-day renewal of exposed vs unexposed members.

offerBank.focus: Women's Day + Main Character Month (format exploration)
offerBank.name: Lift Like a Girl
offerBank.offerDetails: Supreme HQ only, Mon 8–Sun 14 Mar: women new to P57 get their first Strength Lab class free (normally needs the 2-for-1), in off-peak Lab slots. Book a second class before leaving and buy 1 Month or a 12-class pack within 72 hours: the standard 15% (₹17,203 / ₹16,735) plus a free Lab induction seat for a friend.
offerBank.headline: Women's Day isn't about flowers. It's about deadlifts.
offerBank.customerMessage: Women's Day isn't about flowers. It's about deadlifts. Your first Strength Lab class at Supreme HQ is on us, 8–14 March. Bring the attitude; we've got the weights.
offerBank.commercialJob: Use idle Lab capacity at Bandra to acquire new clients and test a strength-first journey.
offerBank.logic: Bandra's Lab runs ~48% full vs Kwality's 83%, so Kwality is excluded. Strength/powerCycle-first visits convert 20.4% vs barre 25.6% today — this tests whether a free, coached Lab first visit closes that gap.
offerBank.rules: Standard 15% only. Max 6 free Lab seats per class.
offerBank.kpi: Lab first visits; Lab-first → purchase vs barre trial (target ≥25%).

offerBank.focus: Women's Day + Main Character Month (format exploration)
offerBank.name: Bura Na Mano, Renewal Hai
offerBank.offerDetails: Holi, Sun 21–Mon 22 Mar (48 hours): 3 Months at 15% off (₹49,177 / ₹35,879) or a 12-class pack at 10% (₹17,719 / ₹11,813), each with a limited-edition 'Holi Hai' P57 tee (retail ≈₹2,000 — confirm).
offerBank.headline: Bura na mano, renewal hai. 48 hours only.
offerBank.customerMessage: Bura na mano, renewal hai. 48 hours only: 3 months at 15% off and a limited-edition Holi tee. Colours wash out. Abs don't.
offerBank.commercialJob: Stop March expiries waiting for April's anniversary pricing.
offerBank.logic: In 2026 Kwality did ₹20.2L in March, then ₹50.0L in April at 20.4% discount depth — March renewals waited. A short, fun window with a 3M upgrade pulls them forward at ≤20% effective.
offerBank.rules: Members expiring 1–31 Mar only. 3M ≈18.5% effective; pack ≈20%.
offerBank.kpi: March renewal yield (target 70%); 3M share of March renewals.

offerBank.focus: Women's Day + Main Character Month (format exploration)
offerBank.name: The Second Date's On Us
offerBank.offerDetails: Kenkere: Newcomers Intro (first class at 50% off, ₹709) → class 2 free if booked at the desk before leaving, within 7 days → 1 Month (₹12,406) or 8-class pack (₹7,408) at the standard 15% within 72 hours of class 2, plus 1 extra freeze. Pop-ups: paid trial (≈₹945) → second class free if booked before leaving → 8- or 10-class pack at 15% within 72 hours.
offerBank.headline: First date: half price. Second date: on us. Third: it's a relationship.
offerBank.customerMessage: First date: half price. Second date: on us. Third date? That's a relationship — 15% off your first month and an extra freeze for when life gets busy.
offerBank.commercialJob: Fix Bengaluru's lead → trial → member leak.
offerBank.logic: Kenkere logged 3,217 leads in 12 months; only 36% reached a trial and 13.1% converted. 581 single-class sales show high drop-in, low commitment. A booked second visit lifts conversion from 10.8% to 43.9%.
offerBank.rules: Standard 15% only; freeze has no cash value.
offerBank.kpi: Second-visit rate (target 55%); trial → member (target 25% vs 18.7%).

offerBank.name: Cloud Nine Limited Edition
offerBank.offerDetails: 9 Months Unlimited + 1 complimentary month (10 months) + 9 freezes (min 3 days each). Mumbai ₹1,64,999 — 99 numbered memberships across Kwality and Supreme HQ. Kenkere ₹1,19,999 — 39 numbered. Works out to ₹16,500 / ₹12,000 a month.
offerBank.headline: Nine years. Nine months. Nine freezes. Plus one month on us.
offerBank.customerMessage: Nine years. Nine months. Nine freezes. Plus one month on us — because we're feeling generous on our birthday. Only 99 numbered memberships in Mumbai and 39 in Bengaluru. When they're gone, they're gone (like your 2018 resolutions).
offerBank.commercialJob: Raise average selling price and lock members past the June–July trough.
offerBank.logic: Kwality's 1M average ticket is ₹16,030; this is ₹1.65L upfront. At ₹16,500/month it sits between 6M list (₹18,953/month) and an annual at 20% (₹14,630/month), so it upsells 1M/3M members without cannibalising annuals. Effective discount vs 10× 1M list: 18.5% Mumbai, 17.8% Bengaluru.
offerBank.rules: Long-plan purchase ≤20% effective. Numbered, no extra units added. 15% newcomer/lapsed perks don't stack.
offerBank.kpi: Units sold; repeat purchase at expiry.

offerBank.name: Club Nine: The Founders' Table
offerBank.offerDetails: 9 numbered Annual Unlimited seats per studio at the standard 20% (₹1,75,560 / ₹1,24,992) with the annual perks doubled: 4 privates, 8 guest passes, 2 hosted classes, monthly trainer check-ins, a numbered jacket, name on the Club Nine wall and 48-hour priority booking all year.
offerBank.headline: Nine numbered seats. Founder perks for a year.
offerBank.customerMessage: Nine numbered annual seats per studio. Twice the perks: 4 privates, 8 guest passes, 2 hosted classes, a numbered jacket and your name on the Club Nine wall. Public seat counter. No seat ever added.
offerBank.commercialJob: Sell annuals at the standard rate by adding status instead of extra discount.
offerBank.logic: Kwality sold 34 annuals on a flat 25% code in 2026 (₹9.7L given away). Numbered scarcity, a public counter and perks deliver ≈25% value at a 20% cash discount.
offerBank.rules: ≈25% effective with perks (annual cap). Leftover seats return on Black Friday.
offerBank.kpi: Seats sold out of 9 per studio; guest-pass → new buyer conversion.

offerBank.name: Spin Class (Literally)
offerBank.offerDetails: Renew 1 Month or a 12-class pack in April at 10% off (₹18,215 / ₹17,719; Kenkere ₹13,136 / ₹11,813; pop-up 10-pack ₹7,655) and spin the Wheel of Nine. Published odds: +1 class 30%, smoothie 20%, guest pass 15%, grip socks 10%, +3 days 10%, extra freeze 8%, 30-min private 5%, P57 tote 1.5%, a free month 0.5%. Expected value ≈₹1,900 Mumbai / ₹1,350 Bengaluru.
offerBank.headline: Renew, then spin. Every spin wins.
offerBank.customerMessage: Renew in April, get 10% off, then spin the Wheel of Nine. Every spin wins — from smoothies to a free month. The odds are printed on the wall, because we're fit, not shady.
offerBank.commercialJob: Protect the April 1M/pack ticket while keeping the month exciting.
offerBank.logic: April 2026 discount depth was 20.4% at Kwality and 20.6% at Bandra on blanket codes. A sure 10% plus a game worth ~9% keeps the average 1M ticket near ₹18,000 instead of ~₹14,000.
offerBank.rules: One spin per renewal, ≈19.5% effective at expected value.
offerBank.kpi: 1M average ticket (target ≥₹18,000); spins filmed and shared.

offerBank.name: Party Crasher Pass
offerBank.offerDetails: Mumbai: 3 classes in 9 days for ₹999, any formats, including a Birthday Bash party class (17–18 Apr); Lab seat at Supreme HQ only. Kenkere: 3 barre classes for ₹699 (replaces the 50% intro in April; counts as the once-in-a-lifetime 2-for-1). Pop-ups: 2 classes for ₹999. The pass price is credited against a first 1 Month or 12-class pack bought within 72 hours of class 3, on top of the standard 15% — 1 Month nets ₹16,204 / ₹11,707.
offerBank.headline: It's our 9th birthday and you're invited. 3 classes for ₹999.
offerBank.customerMessage: It's our 9th birthday and you're invited. 3 classes for ₹999 (Bengaluru ₹699) — including the party class. Love it? Your ₹999 comes off your first month.
offerBank.commercialJob: Fill April's trial pipeline with high-intent newcomers at a 20% effective cap.
offerBank.logic: 3+ visits convert 73–94%. A paid pass filters no-shows (free trials have no attendance data); crediting it plus the standard 15% lands exactly at a 20% effective discount.
offerBank.rules: One per person. Effective 20% on conversion.
offerBank.kpi: Passes sold; 3-visit completion (target 65%); pass → member (target 40%).

offerBank.name: Where Are They Now?
offerBank.offerDetails: Lapsed 61 days–3 years: the standard 15% on 1 Month, a 12-class pack or 3 Months, plus a bonus for every year since your first class (max 3): +1 class on packs, +1 day on unlimited. Seat at the Throwback Reunion (Sat 24 Apr): a class with a row for every cohort, Class of 2018 to Class of 2026.
offerBank.headline: You joined us in {year}. A lot has changed (we got prettier).
offerBank.customerMessage: You joined us in {year}. A lot has changed (we got prettier). Come back for our 9th birthday: 15% off, a bonus class for every year you've known us, and a seat at the Throwback Reunion.
offerBank.commercialJob: Reactivate lapsed clients using the most personal reason in the brand's anniversary month.
offerBank.logic: A personal anniversary in the brand's anniversary month is a stronger trigger than a generic code. Bandra's reactivation pool is the largest; the reunion is a public attendance moment.
offerBank.rules: Standard lapsed 15% + max 3 bonus classes (≤20% effective on a 12-class pack).
offerBank.kpi: Personalised sends; reunion RSVPs; reactivations.

offerBank.name: Plus One, Plus Nine
offerBank.offerDetails: Any active member whose new friend buys in April gets +9 days (pack members: +2 classes). Three buying friends = a free month. The friend gets the standard 15% and a Cloud Nine tote.
offerBank.headline: Bring a friend, get 9 days. Bring three, get a month.
offerBank.customerMessage: It's our birthday, so we're giving presents for presents. Bring a friend who joins: +9 days on us. Bring three: a whole free month. They get 15% off and a Cloud Nine tote.
offerBank.commercialJob: Make April the referral peak of the year.
offerBank.logic: Referral is the best converting source in every studio (22.6–76.1%) and Kwality's third-largest lead source. The reward is only paid when a new client buys, so it is acquisition spend, not discount.
offerBank.rules: Friend must be new (phone verified). Max 1 free month per member.
offerBank.kpi: Referred buyers (target 2× Apr-26); members with 3 referrals.

offerBank.focus: Students home for the holidays + Mother's Day
offerBank.name: Mom Said Get Off the Couch

offerBank.headline: Home for the summer and Mom's already said 'do something'?
offerBank.customerMessage: Home for the summer and Mom's already said 'do something'? 8 classes at 20% off for students — in the hours when the studio is basically yours.
offerBank.commercialJob: Fill empty off-peak seats and recruit the next generation of members.
offerBank.logic: Weekday 10–12 and weekend 4–7 pm run 27–41% full; the marginal cost of a seat there is near zero. Students arriving home in May are a predictable, untapped audience.
offerBank.rules: Discount only exists in empty slots; ≤20%.
offerBank.kpi: Golden Hours fill (target +15 pts); student repeat purchase.

months.name: February
months.objective: Run Stronger in 30 2.0 (members-only, 1 Feb–2 Mar) as Q1's attendance engine; pair acquisition through Valentine's/Galentine's; finishers renew onto longer plans.
months.strategy:
Valentine's + Stronger in 30 2.0.

Commercial job: Run Stronger in 30 2.0 (members-only, 1 Feb–2 Mar) as Q1's attendance engine; pair acquisition through Valentine's/Galentine's; finishers renew onto longer plans.

Newcomer: Situationship → Relationship (“Stop situationship-ing your fitness. Two dates, then make it official.”). Kenkere's VDAY50! code (38 uses, ₹2.6L given away at 50%) bought February volume at a huge cost. This replaces 50% with a structured path: a booked second visit lifts conversion from 10.8% to 43.9%; the challenge gives a reason to keep coming.

Referral: Couples Therapy (Cheaper Than the Real Thing) (“Couples therapy, but cheaper and with better glutes.”). Referrals convert 41.2% at Kwality, 22.6% at Bandra, 28.3% at Kenkere and 76.1% at pop-ups, versus 3.8–5.7% for website leads. The 2026 BOGO codes (70 uses, ₹3.1L given) went mostly to existing clients; this only pays out when a new person buys.

Renewal: Proof of Work (“You did 30 in 30. Your renewal price should show it.”). Renewers average 6.4 visits in the first half of a membership vs 2.6–3.4 for lapsers; members using 75%+ of sessions renew 82–88% across studios. The best price only goes to proven attenders.

Lapsed: Galentine's Gone Ghost (“Your bestie's been ghosting the gym too? Come back together.”). Lapsed clients already know the product and bring friends who convert like referrals (22–76%). Pairing two hesitant people raises the odds both show up.

months.objective: Flagship month: win on excitement and economics. Every offer is tied to a game or event, cash discounts stay ≤20% (25% only on annuals), and value comes from upgrades (Cloud Nine 9-month, Club Nine annuals) and buyers who stay after April.
months.strategy:
Cloud Nine — 9 Years of Physique 57.

Commercial job: Flagship month: win on excitement and economics. Every offer is tied to a game or event, cash discounts stay ≤20% (25% only on annuals), and value comes from upgrades (Cloud Nine 9-month, Club Nine annuals) and buyers who stay after April.

Upgrade: Cloud Nine Limited Edition (“Nine years. Nine months. Nine freezes. Plus one month on us.”). Kwality's 1M average ticket is ₹16,030; this is ₹1.65L upfront. At ₹16,500/month it sits between 6M list (₹18,953/month) and an annual at 20% (₹14,630/month), so it upsells 1M/3M members without cannibalising annuals. Effective discount vs 10× 1M list: 18.5% Mumbai, 17.8% Bengaluru.

Renewal: Club Nine: The Founders' Table (“Nine numbered seats. Founder perks for a year.”). Kwality sold 34 annuals on a flat 25% code in 2026 (₹9.7L given away). Numbered scarcity, a public counter and perks deliver ≈25% value at a 20% cash discount.

Renewal: Spin Class (Literally) (“Renew, then spin. Every spin wins.”). April 2026 discount depth was 20.4% at Kwality and 20.6% at Bandra on blanket codes. A sure 10% plus a game worth ~9% keeps the average 1M ticket near ₹18,000 instead of ~₹14,000.

Newcomer: Party Crasher Pass (“It's our 9th birthday and you're invited. 3 classes for ₹999.”). 3+ visits convert 73–94%. A paid pass filters no-shows (free trials have no attendance data); crediting it plus the standard 15% lands exactly at a 20% effective discount.

Lapsed: Where Are They Now? (“You joined us in {year}. A lot has changed (we got prettier).”). A personal anniversary in the brand's anniversary month is a stronger trigger than a generic code. Bandra's reactivation pool is the largest; the reunion is a public attendance moment.

Referral: Plus One, Plus Nine (“Bring a friend, get 9 days. Bring three, get a month.”). Referral is the best converting source in every studio (22.6–76.1%) and Kwality's third-largest lead source. The reward is only paid when a new client buys, so it is acquisition spend, not discount.
months.notes: Build: 106 new buyers × ₹8,411 first-60-day spend = ₹8.9L; 77 renewals × ₹21,797 = ₹16.8L; 54 winbacks = ₹5.9L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹1.3L. Offers carry ₹24.3L (74% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 52% CRM status, trial→member 21.6%) — not invented lifts.

months.strategy:
Home for the Holidays.

Commercial job: Students home from college fill empty off-peak seats; Mother's Day duos; keep April's buyers attending.

Newcomer: Mom Said Get Off the Couch (“Home for the summer and Mom's already said 'do something'?”). Weekday 10–12 and weekend 4–7 pm run 27–41% full; the marginal cost of a seat there is near zero. Students arriving home in May are a predictable, untapped audience.

Newcomer: Group Project (Finally, Everyone Pulls Their Weight) (“Group projects: usually one person does all the work. Not here.”). Bulk purchase is one of the few places 25% is allowed. Groups attend together (higher usage → higher renewal) and bring four new names per sale.

Newcomer: Mom-entum (“She carried you for 9 months. You can carry her to class.”). Duos with a booked second class convert best; Mother's Day gives a reason. The perk is a shared session, not a bigger discount.

Renewal: Don't Ghost Us After the Party (“Great party. Now show up 8 times in May.”). 2026 anniversary-code buyers renewed at only 24.5%. Attendance in the month after purchase is the best predictor of renewal; the reward is earned by it.

months.name: June
months.objective: Grow privates with off-peak pricing and bulk packs (Bandra's biggest gap); stop summer travel lapses with freezes, not discounts; test a private-first intro.
months.strategy:
Privates Month + Out of Office.

Commercial job: Grow privates with off-peak pricing and bulk packs (Bandra's biggest gap); stop summer travel lapses with freezes, not discounts; test a private-first intro.

Privates: Happy Hour (Zero Hangover, All Glutes) (“Happy hour, but the only thing on tap is a trainer.”). Privates are 6.2% of Kwality's revenue (₹20.1L in 12 months) but only ₹31k at Bandra — the biggest product gap in the portfolio. Quiet-hour pricing uses capacity that is otherwise unpaid.

Privates: Private Practice (“Ten sessions. One trainer who knows your knees better than your physio.”). Bulk private purchase is one of the allowed 25% cases. Kwality's PR1V@TE10 code (39 uses) shows demand; a pack converts one-off buyers into a 6-month relationship.

Commercial job: Studio bookouts and corporate bulk as new channels; protect monsoon renewals; bring lapsed clients back before the race.

Commercial job: Attendance-led renewals and upgrades; a 14-day Rookie intro; Friendship Day referrals; a one-day Independence Day annual.

Renewal: Medal Detector (“Finished the race? Your renewal just found gold.”). Race attendance lifts usage into the 75%+ band where renewal is 82–88%. August is Mumbai's second peak (Kwality ₹30.0L, Bandra ₹22.8L in Aug-26).

months.name: September
months.focus: The Comeback (winback month) + 57 Days to Diwali
months.objective: Winback month: manager calls for high-value lapsed clients, fast comebacks for recent lapsers; a results-guarantee bundle; lock 3M plans before the festive dip.
months.strategy:
The Comeback + 57 Days to Diwali.

Commercial job: Winback month: manager calls for high-value lapsed clients, fast comebacks for recent lapsers; a results-guarantee bundle; lock 3M plans before the festive dip.

Lapsed: We Need to Talk (“We need to talk. Not like that — we just miss you.”). These clients bought big before; a long plan at a serious price fits them. A personal call converts better than a broadcast.

Lapsed: New Phone, Who Dis? (“New phone, who dis? (It's us. Your favourite class.)”). A free first step lowers the barrier; the 7-day window keeps the decision fast. The freeze has no cash cost.

Newcomer: Glow-Up or Give Back (“57 days to Diwali. Glow up, or we give back.”). New clients' first 60-day spend averages ₹11,150 at Kwality, ₹8,411 at Bandra and ₹6,747 at Kenkere — under one month's list price. A 2-month bundle doubles it; the 30-class condition makes the guarantee rarely paid.

Renewal: Lock It Before the Laddoos (“Lock it before the laddoos.”). October–December are troughs (Kwality Nov-25 ₹18.5L; Bandra Oct-25 ₹10.2L). Locking 3M before the festive season protects the base.
months.notes: Build: 58 new buyers × ₹8,411 first-60-day spend = ₹4.9L; 42 renewals × ₹21,797 = ₹9.2L; 29 winbacks = ₹3.2L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹0.7L. Offers carry ₹13.5L (75% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 52% CRM status, trial→member 21.6%) — not invented lifts.

months.name: February
months.objective: Run Stronger in 30 2.0 (members-only, 1 Feb–2 Mar) as Q1's attendance engine; pair acquisition through Valentine's/Galentine's; finishers renew onto longer plans.
months.strategy:
Valentine's + Stronger in 30 2.0.

Commercial job: Run Stronger in 30 2.0 (members-only, 1 Feb–2 Mar) as Q1's attendance engine; pair acquisition through Valentine's/Galentine's; finishers renew onto longer plans.

Newcomer: Situationship → Relationship (“Stop situationship-ing your fitness. Two dates, then make it official.”). Kenkere's VDAY50! code (38 uses, ₹2.6L given away at 50%) bought February volume at a huge cost. This replaces 50% with a structured path: a booked second visit lifts conversion from 10.8% to 43.9%; the challenge gives a reason to keep coming.

Referral: Couples Therapy (Cheaper Than the Real Thing) (“Couples therapy, but cheaper and with better glutes.”). Referrals convert 41.2% at Kwality, 22.6% at Bandra, 28.3% at Kenkere and 76.1% at pop-ups, versus 3.8–5.7% for website leads. The 2026 BOGO codes (70 uses, ₹3.1L given) went mostly to existing clients; this only pays out when a new person buys.

Renewal: Proof of Work (“You did 30 in 30. Your renewal price should show it.”). Renewers average 6.4 visits in the first half of a membership vs 2.6–3.4 for lapsers; members using 75%+ of sessions renew 82–88% across studios. The best price only goes to proven attenders.

Lapsed: Galentine's Gone Ghost (“Your bestie's been ghosting the gym too? Come back together.”). Lapsed clients already know the product and bring friends who convert like referrals (22–76%). Pairing two hesitant people raises the odds both show up.
months.notes: Build: 55 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹6.2L; 60 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹14.1L; 27 winbacks = ₹3.1L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹2.3L. months.strategy:
Cloud Nine — 9 Years of Physique 57.

Commercial job: Flagship month: win on excitement and economics. Every offer is tied to a game or event, cash discounts stay ≤20% (25% only on annuals), and value comes from upgrades (Cloud Nine 9-month, Club Nine annuals) and buyers who stay after April.

Upgrade: Cloud Nine Limited Edition (“Nine years. Nine months. Nine freezes. Plus one month on us.”). Kwality's 1M average ticket is ₹16,030; this is ₹1.65L upfront. At ₹16,500/month it sits between 6M list (₹18,953/month) and an annual at 20% (₹14,630/month), so it upsells 1M/3M members without cannibalising annuals. Effective discount vs 10× 1M list: 18.5% Mumbai, 17.8% Bengaluru.

Renewal: Club Nine: The Founders' Table (“Nine numbered seats. Founder perks for a year.”). Kwality sold 34 annuals on a flat 25% code in 2026 (₹9.7L given away). Numbered scarcity, a public counter and perks deliver ≈25% value at a 20% cash discount.

Renewal: Spin Class (Literally) (“Renew, then spin. Every spin wins.”). April 2026 discount depth was 20.4% at Kwality and 20.6% at Bandra on blanket codes. A sure 10% plus a game worth ~9% keeps the average 1M ticket near ₹18,000 instead of ~₹14,000.

Newcomer: Party Crasher Pass (“It's our 9th birthday and you're invited. 3 classes for ₹999.”). 3+ visits convert 73–94%. A paid pass filters no-shows (free trials have no attendance data); crediting it plus the standard 15% lands exactly at a 20% effective discount.

Lapsed: Where Are They Now? (“You joined us in {year}. A lot has changed (we got prettier).”). A personal anniversary in the brand's anniversary month is a stronger trigger than a generic code. Bandra's reactivation pool is the largest; the reunion is a public attendance moment.

Referral: Plus One, Plus Nine (“Bring a friend, get 9 days. Bring three, get a month.”). Referral is the best converting source in every studio (22.6–76.1%) and Kwality's third-largest lead source. The reward is only paid when a new client buys, so it is acquisition spend, not discount.
months.notes: Build: 129 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹14.4L; 141 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹33.0L; 63 winbacks = ₹7.2L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹5.4L. Offers carry ₹45.1L (75% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 51% CRM status, trial→member 26.9%) — not invented lifts.

Commercial job: Students home from college fill empty off-peak seats; Mother's Day duos; keep April's buyers attending.

Newcomer: Mom Said Get Off the Couch (“Home for the summer and Mom's already said 'do something'?”). Weekday 10–12 and weekend 4–7 pm run 27–41% full; the marginal cost of a seat there is near zero. Students arriving home in May are a predictable, untapped audience.

months.objective: Studio bookouts and corporate bulk as new channels; protect monsoon renewals; bring lapsed clients back before the race.
months.strategy:
Book the Studio + Rain Check.

Commercial job: Studio bookouts and corporate bulk as new channels; protect monsoon renewals; bring lapsed clients back before the race.

Bookout: Kitty Party, But Make It Cardio (“Kitty party, but make it cardio.”). Hosted classes are a top lead source (Kwality 394, Bandra 353, Kenkere 281 leads) but convert only 4.6–6.1%. A paid bookout has a host who brings warm friends and pays for the room.

Corporate: Team Building Without the Trust Falls (“Team building without the trust falls.”). Bulk purchase is an allowed 25% case. Corporate buyers bring 10+ new members per sale and fit the monsoon trough.

Renewal: Rain Check (Literally) (“Monsoon happens. Your late-cancel fee doesn't have to.”). Average late cancels per membership: Bandra 1.18, Kenkere 1.36. Late-cancel fees in the monsoon make members feel they 'wasted' a month and lapse.

Lapsed: Gone With the Wind, Back With the Rain (“Left us in the summer heat? Come back for the monsoon.”). An event with a start date beats a generic reminder. Freezes answer the monsoon objection at no cash cost.
months.notes: Build: 72 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹8.1L; 79 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹18.5L; 35 winbacks = ₹4.0L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.0L. months.strategy:
The Amazing Race 2.0.

Commercial job: Attendance-led renewals and upgrades; a 14-day Rookie intro; Friendship Day referrals; a one-day Independence Day annual.

Newcomer: Rookie Mistake (The Only Good One) (“Two weeks unlimited. The only rookie mistake is not trying.”). Clients with 5+ visits in month one buy at 93.5%. A 14-day window lets newcomers reach 5+ visits; the race gives them a reason. Effective 20% on conversion.

Renewal: At the Stroke of the Midnight Hour (“At the stroke of the midnight hour, your annual goes 25% off.”). Annual is the only membership where 25% is allowed. One day and a cap keep it an event, not a price.

Referral: Friends With Benefits (Strictly Fitness) (“Friends with benefits. Strictly fitness.”). Friendship Day falls on race day one. Referred friends convert 22–76% vs 4–6% for website leads.

Renewal: Medal Detector (“Finished the race? Your renewal just found gold.”). Race attendance lifts usage into the 75%+ band where renewal is 82–88%. August is Mumbai's second peak (Kwality ₹30.0L, Bandra ₹22.8L in Aug-26).

months.focus: The Comeback (winback month) + 57 Days to Diwali
months.objective: Winback month: manager calls for high-value lapsed clients, fast comebacks for recent lapsers; a results-guarantee bundle; lock 3M plans before the festive dip.
months.strategy:
The Comeback + 57 Days to Diwali.

Commercial job: Winback month: manager calls for high-value lapsed clients, fast comebacks for recent lapsers; a results-guarantee bundle; lock 3M plans before the festive dip.

Lapsed: We Need to Talk (“We need to talk. Not like that — we just miss you.”). These clients bought big before; a long plan at a serious price fits them. A personal call converts better than a broadcast.

Lapsed: New Phone, Who Dis? (“New phone, who dis? (It's us. Your favourite class.)”). A free first step lowers the barrier; the 7-day window keeps the decision fast. The freeze has no cash cost.

Newcomer: Glow-Up or Give Back (“57 days to Diwali. Glow up, or we give back.”). New clients' first 60-day spend averages ₹11,150 at Kwality, ₹8,411 at Bandra and ₹6,747 at Kenkere — under one month's list price. A 2-month bundle doubles it; the 30-class condition makes the guarantee rarely paid.

Renewal: Lock It Before the Laddoos (“Lock it before the laddoos.”). October–December are troughs (Kwality Nov-25 ₹18.5L; Bandra Oct-25 ₹10.2L). Locking 3M before the festive season protects the base.
months.notes: Build: 85 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹9.5L; 93 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹21.8L; 41 winbacks = ₹4.8L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.6L. Offers carry ₹23.6L (59% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 51% CRM status, trial→member 26.9%) — not invented lifts.

Commercial job: Long commitments in the softest month without discounting 1 Month; a no-purchase member appreciation week that generates guest leads.

Renewal: Black Friday, Strong Monday, Sore Tuesday (“Black Friday, Strong Monday, sore Tuesday.”). November is the trough (Kwality ₹18.5L, Bandra ₹13.2L in Nov-25). Long-plan pricing brings cash forward without discounting 1 Month.

Goodwill: Thank U, Next (Year) (“Thank u, next (year).”). Each guest pass is a referral-quality lead (referrals convert 22–76%). Goodwill before December renewals lifts renewal yield.
months.notes: Build: 46 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹5.1L; 50 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹11.8L; 22 winbacks = ₹2.6L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹1.9L. months.name: January
months.objective: Turn New Year intent into paid commitments that are active on 1 Feb; re-up the annuals due Dec–Feb; test the 3-for-2 newcomer pack.
months.strategy:
Resolutions with Receipts.

Commercial job: Turn New Year intent into paid commitments that are active on 1 Feb; re-up the annuals due Dec–Feb; test the 3-for-2 newcomer pack.

Spot: The 57-Hour Hangover Sale (“Hungover? Same. 1 month unlimited, flat ₹15,000. 57 hours only.”). January is the strongest non-April month in Mumbai (Jan-26: Kwality ₹27.4L, Bandra ₹20.0L; Kenkere ₹11.1L). A capped spot price creates urgency without training clients to wait — only 57 units per city, so the maximum discount exposure is ~₹3.0L in Mumbai and ~₹2.6L in Bengaluru.

Newcomer: Third Time's the Charm (“First class: awkward. Second: better. Third: hooked. 3 classes for the price of 2.”). 60.6% of first-timers never take a 2nd class. Purchase within 60 days by month-1 visits: 0 return visits 10.8%, 1 → 43.9%, 2 → 73.3%, 3–4 → 88.6%. The 2-for-1 route converts 20.8% (Bandra 17%). A third class moves people into the 73–89% band.

Renewal: The Baker's Dozen (“12 months is so 2026. Renew your annual and get 13.”). Annual is Kwality's #1 product (32 units, ₹51.6L in the last 12 months) and Bandra's #3 (15 units, ₹23.8L). The ANN-2026-25%-KH code gave away ₹9.7L at a flat 25%; this gives less cash away (≈21.5% effective) and adds time, which costs little at spare capacity.

Lapsed: U Up? It's 2027. (“U up? Your mat's been asking about you.”). Bandra is reactivation-led (3,209 lapsed vs 5,065 renewed membership records). Renewal climbs with usage: Bandra members using <50% of sessions renew 49–58% vs 82% at 75%+. The bonus is only paid for attendance that predicts the next renewal.
months.notes: Build: 59 new buyers × ₹6,747 first-60-day spend = ₹4.0L; 41 renewals × ₹15,422 = ₹6.3L; 8 winbacks = ₹0.7L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹0.8L. Offers carry ₹6.1L (52% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 36% CRM status, trial→member 18.7%) — not invented lifts.

offers.name: The 57-Hour Hangover Sale
offers.headline: Hungover? Same. 1 month unlimited, flat ₹15,000. 57 hours only.
offers.benefit: 1 Month Unlimited at a flat ₹15,000 in Mumbai (list ₹20,239, 26% off) or ₹10,000 at Kenkere (list ₹14,595, 31% off). Fri 1 Jan 00:00 to Sun 3 Jan 09:00 — 57 hours. Capped at 57 memberships per city, 1 per person, activate by 15 Jan.
offers.customerCopy: Hungover? Same. For the next 57 hours, 1 Month Unlimited is a flat ₹15,000 (Bengaluru: ₹10,000). Only 57 memberships per city, then it disappears faster than your NYE plans. Start any day before 15 Jan.
offers.description: 1 Month Unlimited at a flat ₹15,000 in Mumbai (list ₹20,239, 26% off) or ₹10,000 at Kenkere (list ₹14,595, 31% off). Fri 1 Jan 00:00 to Sun 3 Jan 09:00 — 57 hours. Capped at 57 memberships per city, 1 per person, activate by 15 Jan.
offers.rationale: January is the strongest non-April month in Mumbai (Jan-26: Kwality ₹27.4L, Bandra ₹20.0L; Kenkere ₹11.1L). A capped spot price creates urgency without training clients to wait — only 57 units per city, so the maximum discount exposure is ~₹3.0L in Mumbai and ~₹2.6L in Bengaluru.
offers.objective: Front-load January cash and capture the resolution spike before it cools.
offers.conditions: Spot offer, so the >25% cap does not apply. Replaces (does not stack with) the 15% newcomer or lapsed perk. Active members may buy it as their next renewal only if their plan ends before 31 Jan.
offers.kpi: Sell-out time; share of spot buyers renewing in Feb at standard price (target 55%).

offers.name: Third Time's the Charm
offers.headline: First class: awkward. Second: better. Third: hooked. 3 classes for the price of 2.
offers.benefit: Replaces the Newcomers 2-for-1 for January. Mumbai: 3 classes for ₹3,885 (price of 2 singles) — mix barre, powerCycle and Strength Lab (Lab seats at Supreme HQ; Kwality off-peak only), use within 14 days. months.objective: Run Stronger in 30 2.0 (members-only, 1 Feb–2 Mar) as Q1's attendance engine; pair acquisition through Valentine's/Galentine's; finishers renew onto longer plans.
months.strategy:
Valentine's + Stronger in 30 2.0.

Commercial job: Run Stronger in 30 2.0 (members-only, 1 Feb–2 Mar) as Q1's attendance engine; pair acquisition through Valentine's/Galentine's; finishers renew onto longer plans.

Newcomer: Situationship → Relationship (“Stop situationship-ing your fitness. Two dates, then make it official.”). Kenkere's VDAY50! code (38 uses, ₹2.6L given away at 50%) bought February volume at a huge cost. This replaces 50% with a structured path: a booked second visit lifts conversion from 10.8% to 43.9%; the challenge gives a reason to keep coming.

Referral: Couples Therapy (Cheaper Than the Real Thing) (“Couples therapy, but cheaper and with better glutes.”). Referrals convert 41.2% at Kwality, 22.6% at Bandra, 28.3% at Kenkere and 76.1% at pop-ups, versus 3.8–5.7% for website leads. The 2026 BOGO codes (70 uses, ₹3.1L given) went mostly to existing clients; this only pays out when a new person buys.

Renewal: Proof of Work (“You did 30 in 30. Your renewal price should show it.”). Renewers average 6.4 visits in the first half of a membership vs 2.6–3.4 for lapsers; members using 75%+ of sessions renew 82–88% across studios. The best price only goes to proven attenders.

Lapsed: Galentine's Gone Ghost (“Your bestie's been ghosting the gym too? Come back together.”). Lapsed clients already know the product and bring friends who convert like referrals (22–76%). Pairing two hesitant people raises the odds both show up.
months.notes: Build: 48 new buyers × ₹6,747 first-60-day spend = ₹3.3L; 33 renewals × ₹15,422 = ₹5.1L; 6 winbacks = ₹0.6L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹0.7L. Offers carry ₹5.7L (60% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 36% CRM status, trial→member 18.7%) — not invented lifts.

months.name: April
months.objective: Flagship month: win on excitement and economics. Every offer is tied to a game or event, cash discounts stay ≤20% (25% only on annuals), and value comes from upgrades (Cloud Nine 9-month, Club Nine annuals) and buyers who stay after April.
months.strategy:
Cloud Nine — 9 Years of Physique 57.

Commercial job: Flagship month: win on excitement and economics. Every offer is tied to a game or event, cash discounts stay ≤20% (25% only on annuals), and value comes from upgrades (Cloud Nine 9-month, Club Nine annuals) and buyers who stay after April.

Upgrade: Cloud Nine Limited Edition (“Nine years. Nine months. Nine freezes. Plus one month on us.”). Kwality's 1M average ticket is ₹16,030; this is ₹1.65L upfront. At ₹16,500/month it sits between 6M list (₹18,953/month) and an annual at 20% (₹14,630/month), so it upsells 1M/3M members without cannibalising annuals. Effective discount vs 10× 1M list: 18.5% Mumbai, 17.8% Bengaluru.

Renewal: Club Nine: The Founders' Table (“Nine numbered seats. Founder perks for a year.”). Kwality sold 34 annuals on a flat 25% code in 2026 (₹9.7L given away). Numbered scarcity, a public counter and perks deliver ≈25% value at a 20% cash discount.

Renewal: Spin Class (Literally) (“Renew, then spin. Every spin wins.”). April 2026 discount depth was 20.4% at Kwality and 20.6% at Bandra on blanket codes. A sure 10% plus a game worth ~9% keeps the average 1M ticket near ₹18,000 instead of ~₹14,000.

Newcomer: Party Crasher Pass (“It's our 9th birthday and you're invited. 3 classes for ₹999.”). 3+ visits convert 73–94%. A paid pass filters no-shows (free trials have no attendance data); crediting it plus the standard 15% lands exactly at a 20% effective discount.

Lapsed: Where Are They Now? (“You joined us in {year}. A lot has changed (we got prettier).”). A personal anniversary in the brand's anniversary month is a stronger trigger than a generic code. Bandra's reactivation pool is the largest; the reunion is a public attendance moment.

Referral: Plus One, Plus Nine (“Bring a friend, get 9 days. Bring three, get a month.”). Referral is the best converting source in every studio (22.6–76.1%) and Kwality's third-largest lead source. The reward is only paid when a new client buys, so it is acquisition spend, not discount.
months.notes: Build: 76 new buyers × ₹6,747 first-60-day spend = ₹5.1L; 52 renewals × ₹15,422 = ₹8.0L; 10 winbacks = ₹0.9L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹1.1L. Offers carry ₹9.6L (63% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 36% CRM status, trial→member 18.7%) — not invented lifts.

months.objective: Studio bookouts and corporate bulk as new channels; protect monsoon renewals; bring lapsed clients back before the race.
months.strategy:
Book the Studio + Rain Check.

Commercial job: Studio bookouts and corporate bulk as new channels; protect monsoon renewals; bring lapsed clients back before the race.

Bookout: Kitty Party, But Make It Cardio (“Kitty party, but make it cardio.”). Hosted classes are a top lead source (Kwality 394, Bandra 353, Kenkere 281 leads) but convert only 4.6–6.1%. A paid bookout has a host who brings warm friends and pays for the room.

Renewal: Rain Check (Literally) (“Monsoon happens. Your late-cancel fee doesn't have to.”). Average late cancels per membership: Bandra 1.18, Kenkere 1.36. Late-cancel fees in the monsoon make members feel they 'wasted' a month and lapse.

Lapsed: Gone With the Wind, Back With the Rain (“Left us in the summer heat? Come back for the monsoon.”). An event with a start date beats a generic reminder. Freezes answer the monsoon objection at no cash cost.
months.notes: Build: 63 new buyers × ₹6,747 first-60-day spend = ₹4.2L; 43 renewals × ₹15,422 = ₹6.6L; 8 winbacks = ₹0.7L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹0.9L. Commercial job: Attendance-led renewals and upgrades; a 14-day Rookie intro; Friendship Day referrals; a one-day Independence Day annual.

Commercial job: Run Stronger in 30 2.0 (members-only, 1 Feb–2 Mar) as Q1's attendance engine; pair acquisition through Valentine's/Galentine's; finishers renew onto longer plans.

Newcomer: Situationship → Relationship (“Stop situationship-ing your fitness. Two dates, then make it official.”). Kenkere's VDAY50! code (38 uses, ₹2.6L given away at 50%) bought February volume at a huge cost. This replaces 50% with a structured path: a booked second visit lifts conversion from 10.8% to 43.9%; the challenge gives a reason to keep coming.

Referral: Couples Therapy (Cheaper Than the Real Thing) (“Couples therapy, but cheaper and with better glutes.”). Referrals convert 41.2% at Kwality, 22.6% at Bandra, 28.3% at Kenkere and 76.1% at pop-ups, versus 3.8–5.7% for website leads. The 2026 BOGO codes (70 uses, ₹3.1L given) went mostly to existing clients; this only pays out when a new person buys.

Renewal: Proof of Work (“You did 30 in 30. Your renewal price should show it.”). Renewers average 6.4 visits in the first half of a membership vs 2.6–3.4 for lapsers; members using 75%+ of sessions renew 82–88% across studios. The best price only goes to proven attenders.

Lapsed: Galentine's Gone Ghost (“Your bestie's been ghosting the gym too? Come back together.”). Lapsed clients already know the product and bring friends who convert like referrals (22–76%). Pairing two hesitant people raises the odds both show up.

months.strategy:
Cloud Nine — 9 Years of Physique 57.

Commercial job: Flagship month: win on excitement and economics. Every offer is tied to a game or event, cash discounts stay ≤20% (25% only on annuals), and value comes from upgrades (Cloud Nine 9-month, Club Nine annuals) and buyers who stay after April.

Renewal: Spin Class (Literally) (“Renew, then spin. Every spin wins.”). April 2026 discount depth was 20.4% at Kwality and 20.6% at Bandra on blanket codes. A sure 10% plus a game worth ~9% keeps the average 1M ticket near ₹18,000 instead of ~₹14,000.

Newcomer: Party Crasher Pass (“It's our 9th birthday and you're invited. 3 classes for ₹999.”). 3+ visits convert 73–94%. A paid pass filters no-shows (free trials have no attendance data); crediting it plus the standard 15% lands exactly at a 20% effective discount.

Lapsed: Where Are They Now? (“You joined us in {year}. A lot has changed (we got prettier).”). A personal anniversary in the brand's anniversary month is a stronger trigger than a generic code. Bandra's reactivation pool is the largest; the reunion is a public attendance moment.

Referral: Plus One, Plus Nine (“Bring a friend, get 9 days. Bring three, get a month.”). Referral is the best converting source in every studio (22.6–76.1%) and Kwality's third-largest lead source. The reward is only paid when a new client buys, so it is acquisition spend, not discount.
months.notes: Build: 40 new buyers × ₹2,087 first-60-day spend = ₹0.8L; 9 renewals × ₹7,241 = ₹0.7L; 0 winbacks = ₹0.0L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹0.0L. Offers carry ₹1.1L (70% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 26% CRM status, trial→member 32.9%) — not invented lifts.

months.name: December
months.objective: Renew on personal usage data, pre-sell January, and turn Christmas gifting into new clients.
months.strategy:
Wrapped.

Commercial job: Renew on personal usage data, pre-sell January, and turn Christmas gifting into new clients.

Renewal: Wrapped: Your Top Artist Was Your Trainer (“Your top artist this year? Your trainer.”). A usage-based recommendation renews members onto plans that fit; year-in-review pages get shared.

Renewal: 12 Days of Shakemas (“Twelve days, twelve published deals. Day 12 is the big one.”). Published, rotating deals create daily traffic; the best prices sit on the longest plans and bulk privates (the allowed 25% cases).

Newcomer: Secret Santa Squats (“Secret Santa budget ₹2,000? Gift squats.”). Secret Santa budgets cluster at ₹1–2k; a voucher at that price reaches new people through colleagues. Effective 20% on conversion.

Lapsed: Last Seen: 2026 (We Noticed) (“Last seen: 2026. We noticed.”). Long-lapsed clients need a fresh start, not a bigger discount; the challenge gives a dated goal.
months.notes: Build: 45 new buyers × ₹2,087 first-60-day spend = ₹0.9L; 10 renewals × ₹7,241 = ₹0.7L; 0 winbacks = ₹0.0L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹0.0L. Offers carry ₹0.8L (45% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 26% CRM status, trial→member 32.9%) — not invented lifts.

funnel.dataQuality: lead→trial = CRM 'Trial Completed' status (not attendance-verified); trial→member = trailing measured; see dataGaps
